newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.5 billion yuan from 1.7 billion yuan on Wednesday with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said trading volume kept low today with the market had already been in a holiday mood before the Chinese lunar new year holiday from February 7 to 11.
"Many instititions did less business today due to the approaching holiday," said one trader.

The 60-day contract was the most active because its duration covered the lunar new year period and extend to the end of March. Some institutions thought the rates were modest compared to other late-maturing contracts, traders said.
"Trading can be more active only after the lunar new year holiday," said a second trader.
